interactables.text: The [Husband] lifts one headphone. 'That audio guy barged past me in the hall around [seven]. Didn't even apologize. Very rude.'
A crew manifest on the dresser. Multiple names. One line stands out: '[D. Marsh] — 2x Acoustic Cases (sound-proof) — [7:00 PM].'
Massive road cases. The label reads: '[Acoustic Isolation] — No Sound Transmission.' You press an ear to the surface. Silence. Whatever's inside, you wouldn't hear it [squawk].
A handwritten note on the nightstand: 'Derek — Rudebeak woke me up at 5AM. AGAIN. Do [SOMETHING] about that bird or I am calling my [lawyer].' — M.
An open box for top-of-the-line noise-canceling headphones. Purchase receipt inside: [yesterday's date]. Someone finally [snapped].

localDeductionSentence: The [Husband's Grumble] places a nervous crew member in the hallway at 7:00 PM — when [D. Marsh — 7:00 PM] signed in two [Sound-Proof Cases] big enough to hide a very loud bird.
